_readme: Editable assumptions file. Every numeric value used by the engine lives here (or in the UI-edited copy of this file in localStorage). ALL values below are DEMO ASSUMPTIONS, not verified IPCC/CEA numbers. Replace each with a verified factor, set status to 'verified', and fill sourceName/sourceUrl/year before relying on any result. sourceUrl fields point to general landing pages where a verified value can be looked up; they are NOT citations of the demo values.

factors.name: Diesel combustion emission factor
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Where to verify: IPCC Emission Factor Database / 2006 IPCC Guidelines Vol. 2 (stationary & mobile combustion), converted to per-litre using India-specific diesel density and calorific value.

factors.name: Grid electricity emission factor (location-based)
factors.sourceName: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, v17.0 (Oct 2021), FY2020-21 weighted average
factors.notes: Value 0.79 tCO2/MWh is the all-India weighted average read from v17. Newer versions exist (CEA publishes v18-v22) and are lower or different: update to the vintage matching your reporting year. Low/high is a demo band around it, not a CEA range.

factors.name: Explosives (blasting agent) emission factor
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Placeholder for a generic explosive. Replace with a supplier/EPD or inventory-database value for the blasting agent actually used.

factors.name: Fugitive methane intensity — open-cast
factors.sourceName: IPCC 2019 Refinement, Vol 2 Ch 4 (Fugitive emissions), coal mining Tier 1 defaults
factors.notes: Surface mining 0.3/1.2/2.0 m3 CH4/t + surface post-mining 0/0.1/0.2 = 0.3/1.3/2.2 m3/t, converted at 0.67 kg/m3. Tier 1 global default; replace with mine-specific data when available.

factors.name: Fugitive methane intensity — underground
factors.sourceName: IPCC 2019 Refinement, Vol 2 Ch 4 (Fugitive emissions), coal mining Tier 1 defaults
factors.notes: Underground mining 10/18/25 m3 CH4/t (low/default/high) + post-mining 0.9/2.5/4.0 = 10.9/20.5/29.0 m3/t, converted at 0.67 kg/m3 (CH4 density at standard conditions). Tier 1 global default: a mine-specific measurement or Indian/CMPDI value should replace it. Range = IPCC low/high.

factors.name: Global warming potential of methane (100-yr)
factors.sourceName: GHG Protocol, IPCC Global Warming Potential Values (v2.0, Aug 2024)
factors.notes: Value = AR6 GWP-100 for fossil methane (29.8). AR5 fossil = 30; non-fossil AR5 28 / AR6 27.0. Range spans these report choices. Use one report consistently.

factors.name: Methane destruction efficiency of capture system (drained gas flared/utilised)
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Share of captured methane that is destroyed rather than leaked. The mine's own 'capture rate' input is applied on top of this.

factors.name: Scope 3: downstream combustion of sold coal
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Memo item only; never part of the Scope 1+2 inventory or the neutrality calculation. Depends strongly on coal grade.

factors.name: Annual decline of grid emission factor
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Models gradual grid decarbonisation outside the mine's control. Set to 0 for a frozen grid.

factors.name: Electricity needed per litre of diesel displaced (electric haul fleet)
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Electrification cuts diesel but adds grid demand; this ties the two together so Scope 2 rises when diesel falls.

factors.name: Maximum share of diesel use that can be electrified
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: At 100% adoption this fraction of haulage and equipment diesel is displaced. Applied equally to both sources (simplification).

factors.name: Plantation carbon stock at maturity (Chapman–Richards asymptote)
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Stock C(age) = Cmax·(1−e^(−k·age))^p. Annual removal is the year-on-year change in stock. Depends on species, site and mine-spoil quality. Not verified.

factors.name: Growth-rate parameter k
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Controls how fast the stock approaches maturity.

factors.name: Growth-curve shape parameter p
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: p > 1 makes early-year removal slow and mid-life removal fastest (S-shaped stock curve).

factors.name: Plantation survival rate
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Fraction of planted area that survives to follow the growth curve.

factors.name: Soil-carbon confidence multiplier
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Soil carbon is hard to verify. The user's estimate is scaled by this multiplier; low/high give the confidence range used in Monte Carlo.

factors.name: Diesel price
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Used for avoided-fuel savings from fleet electrification. Placeholder cost.

factors.name: Purchased electricity price
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Used to cost the extra electricity of an electric fleet. Placeholder cost.

factors.name: Fleet electrification capex per annual litre displaced
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Placeholder. Includes vehicles and charging infrastructure; spent in proportion to adoption growth.

factors.name: Fleet electrification annual O&M as fraction of installed capex
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Placeholder cost.

factors.name: Methane capture capex per tCO2e/yr of capacity
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Placeholder. Capacity is sized on the baseline (no-capture) methane of the first year.

factors.name: Methane capture operating cost per tCO2e destroyed
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Placeholder. Net of any gas-sale revenue (none assumed).

factors.name: Renewable PPA price premium over grid tariff
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Can be negative if the PPA is cheaper than the grid. Placeholder cost.

factors.name: Afforestation establishment cost
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Placeholder cost.

factors.name: Afforestation maintenance cost
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Applied to every planted hectare from the year it is planted. Placeholder cost.

factors.name: Carbon credit price
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Placeholder. Credits are offsets, shown separately and never subtracted from gross emissions.

factors.name: Discount rate for cost comparison
factors.sourceName: Demo assumption — replace with a verified factor
factors.notes: Used to compute present-value cost for the MAC ranking.

factors.name: Validation band: lower bound of Scope 1+2 intensity
factors.sourceName: CodeSpark 2026 problem statement (hackathon brief); not independently verified
factors.notes: The brief cites roughly 0.1–0.5 tCO2e per tonne mined including methane, depending on gassiness. Used only for a plausibility check.

factors.name: Validation band: upper bound of Scope 1+2 intensity
factors.sourceName: CodeSpark 2026 problem statement (hackathon brief); not independently verified
factors.notes: See lower bound.
